newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bourse trade halted due technical problems.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bourse trade halted due technical problems.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange said pre-open trade had been halted before the scheduled 1030 (0830 GMT) official opening on Tuesday due to technical problems in the HETI trading system.
"Trading has been stopped due to technical problems," a bourse spokeswoman said by telephone. She said she had no further details.
Another bourse official said he expected that trade could resume by about 1200/1000 GMT.
"The stoppage is unlikely to be long," he said, adding that the reason for the technical problems was not yet known.
